description: Answer key for the good sample project. A competent reviewer should find only a few minor gaps: thin literature synthesis, no research-gap statement, limited error analysis, no variability or significance testing, no unit tests and no presentation. It must NOT turn the scanner's 'cross-validation mentioned but not implemented' signal into an IMPL-002 finding: the report says cross-validation was NOT run (Limitations).

expected_findings.label: problem definition / research question
expected_findings.why: README + report.md section 1.2 state an explicit, testable RQ.

expected_findings.label: measurable objective
expected_findings.why: report.md 1.3: primary metric F1 (churn class), threshold F1 >= 0.55.

expected_findings.label: inputs/outputs, why ML
expected_findings.why: report.md 1.4 argues against a single rule; the rule is not tested empirically.

expected_findings.label: scope, assumptions, limitations
expected_findings.why: report.md 1.5 and 7 (project-specific limitations).

expected_findings.label: literature review
expected_findings.why: Section 2 is an annotated list with one linking sentence; little synthesis or comparison.

expected_findings.label: recent literature
expected_findings.why: Newest churn paper is 2012; only Kapoor & Narayanan 2023 is recent and it is not churn-specific.

expected_findings.label: verifiable citations
expected_findings.why: All six references exist (5 DOIs resolve on Crossref; Pedregosa 2011 JMLR URL) and support the claims they are cited for.

expected_findings.label: research gap
expected_findings.why: No explicit gap; the project is only loosely positioned ('follows this literature').

expected_findings.label: dataset source and license
expected_findings.why: data/README.md: synthetic, CC0, generator script included.

expected_findings.label: dataset documentation
expected_findings.why: Size, columns, target and class distribution in data/README.md and report Table 1; they match the CSV.

expected_findings.label: data quality
expected_findings.why: Missing values and duplicate IDs checked and handled; outliers not discussed.

expected_findings.label: train/test split, no leakage
expected_findings.why: Stratified 80/20 split, all preprocessing inside the Pipeline, no target-derived features.

expected_findings.label: bias and dataset limitations
expected_findings.why: Synthetic-data bias (favours LR) and age-group fairness discussed.

expected_findings.label: baseline
expected_findings.why: DummyClassifier (majority) + Logistic Regression baseline in src/train.py and report Table 3.

expected_findings.label: model choice justified
expected_findings.why: report.md 4.3 justifies LR and RF.

expected_findings.label: preprocessing/training documented
expected_findings.why: report.md 4.1-4.2 match src/preprocess.py.

expected_findings.label: hyperparameters
expected_findings.why: Fixed hyperparameters documented in Table 2; no tuning, so the test set is never used for selection.

expected_findings.label: complete, modular implementation
expected_findings.why: src/ split into preprocess/train/evaluate; runs end-to-end.

expected_findings.label: code matches report
expected_findings.why: Models, split and metrics match. Trap: the CV keyword in report.md Limitations is a negation, not a claim.

expected_findings.label: no hardcoded paths
expected_findings.why: Paths derived from Path(__file__); no secrets. PARTIAL is defensible because seed, split size and hyperparameters are constants in code with no separate config file ('configuration is separated from code').

expected_findings.label: code quality / tests
expected_findings.why: Clean code and input checks, but no tests/ directory.

expected_findings.label: controlled comparison
expected_findings.why: All models share the same split, preprocessing and metrics.

expected_findings.label: statistical significance / variability
expected_findings.why: Single split, single seed, no std/CI, no significance test; the 0.02 F1 gap is only acknowledged in Limitations.

expected_findings.label: ablation
expected_findings.why: No multi-component approach whose parts are claimed to contribute.

expected_findings.label: claims supported
expected_findings.why: Every number in report/README is in results/metrics.json.

expected_findings.label: evaluation metrics
expected_findings.why: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1; section 4.4 justifies F1 under 26/74 imbalance.

expected_findings.label: error analysis
expected_findings.why: Confusion matrices only; no failure cases or per-segment analysis (admitted in Limitations).

expected_findings.label: generalization
expected_findings.why: Table 5 train vs test F1; RF overfitting discussed.

expected_findings.label: pinned environment
expected_findings.why: requirements.txt pinned, Python version stated.

expected_findings.label: random seed
expected_findings.why: SEED = 42 passed as random_state everywhere and to default_rng.

expected_findings.label: data + scripts
expected_findings.why: make_dataset.py, preprocess.py, train.py, evaluate.py; README steps.

expected_findings.label: results traceable
expected_findings.why: results/metrics.json produced by src/evaluate.py.

expected_findings.label: README
expected_findings.why: Purpose, structure, step-by-step commands.

expected_findings.label: report structure
expected_findings.why: Abstract through references.

expected_findings.label: ethics
expected_findings.why: Short but project-specific ethics section.

expected_findings.label: presentation
expected_findings.why: No slides.

expected_findings.label: figures/tables accurate
expected_findings.why: All tables match results/metrics.json.
